es: Resultó ser un error de tipeo.
natural: It turned out to be a typo.
calco: It resulted to be a typo.
explicacion: "Resultar" en este sentido es **turn out**. *result* se usa como *result in* (causar) o *result from* (venir de).

natural: I had been waiting for an hour.
calco: I was waiting since one hour.
explicacion: "Llevaba ... -ando" es **had been + -ing**. Con una cantidad de tiempo va **for**, no *since*.

es: Acababa de llegar cuando empezó a llover.
natural: I had just arrived when it started to rain.
calco: I finished to arrive when it started to rain.
explicacion: "Acabar de" no es *finish*: se dice con **just**. En pasado, **had just + participio**.

natural: I had never seen anything like that.
calco: I had never seen nothing like that.
explicacion: En inglés no se usan dos negaciones: con **never** va *anything*, no *nothing*.
